items.text: 新增 Hypit 项目与原生预览接入，复用已有模型配置与素材索引。
items.text_en: Add Hypit projects and native previews using existing model settings and asset indexes.

items.text: 统一项目管理：创建后留在列表，手动打开作品，接入指令通过独立文档提供。
items.text_en: Unified project management: creation stays in the list, works open explicitly, and connection prompts link to dedicated guides.

items.text: 画布 Agent 支持无页面后台执行，增加稳定节点编号与多标签冲突合并。
items.text_en: Canvas agents support headless execution, stable node numbers and multi-tab conflict merging.

items.text: 抽出项目与任务编排模块，保留平台适配器复用；进一步底层统一仍在进行。
items.text_en: Extract project and task orchestration modules while reusing provider adapters; further unification remains in progress.

items.text: 修复 Hypit 打开地址、项目列表错误状态和新建项目提前打开标签的问题。
items.text_en: Fix Hypit project URLs, project-list error states and premature tab opening.
